text: I know this but don't let it break your focus The feeling of being gone will make things easier Don't make sense at all to all the people who believe in you It's quite tragic when you give up on living Now realizing you possess a life that's never worth giving Without using it to the fullest extent and make a difference Empower yourself and show all the men, women and children You can't survive through the darkness and become the light Don't let the complication consume you from choosing life I know it's hard in this cold world but we can make it through it
